claims: The Derpy McFlurry is a limited-time dessert.
The Derpy McFlurry was launched on March 31, 2026.
The Derpy McFlurry was launched as part of the McDonald's x KPop Demon Hunters collaboration.
The Derpy McFlurry is inspired by the character Derpy.
The Derpy McFlurry features vanilla soft serve.
The Derpy McFlurry features wild berry sauce.
The Derpy McFlurry features berry-flavored popping pearls.
The Derpy McFlurry is available in the U.S. at McDonald's locations starting March 31, 2026.
The Derpy McFlurry is available while supplies last.
The official nutrition summary notes that a mini version of the Derpy McFlurry contains approximately 230 calories.
The official nutrition summary notes that a mini version of the Derpy McFlurry contains 5g of protein.
The official nutrition summary notes that a mini version of the Derpy McFlurry contains 43g of carbohydrates.
McDonald's Australia offers the Derpy McFlurry with brown sugar sauce.
McDonald's Australia offers the Derpy McFlurry with tapioca pearls.
The Derpy McFlurry is part of a larger South Korean-inspired menu.
The South Korean-inspired menu includes collectible photocards.
The South Korean-inspired menu includes specialized dipping sauces
